tr: Kuzu sürüde; sen her gece dünkü sayıyı sayıyorsun.
en: The lamb is in the flock; every night you count yesterday's number.

tr: Değirmencinin kızı yedi yaşındayken defterini okudu.
en: The miller's daughter read your book when she was seven.
The stream did not dry; the mill is drinking it.

tr: Defterindeki günler yanlış değil; kasaba senin yazdığın günü yaşıyor.
en: The days in your book are not wrong; the town lives the day you write.

tr: Fincanı otuz yıl önce, ilk gece sen yıkadın.
en: You washed the cup thirty years ago, on the first night.
The midwife chose you before your engagement.
The staff is older than the tower.

tr: Bu dağda bir zaman vakit yok imiş,
en: On this mountain once, they say, there was no time,

tr: Ne ekin bitermiş, ne kar erirmiş,
en: No wheat would ripen and no snow would melt,

tr: Bir yabancı gelmiş, bir kule kurmuş,
en: A stranger came and raised a tower here,
He set a stone inside, and time began to walk.

tr: Taş sallanmış, ekin bitmiş, kar ermiş,
en: The stone swung, the wheat grew, the snow was gone,
The born took names, the dead were laid in earth,
One night the stranger went beneath the stone,
Went down and never came, and no one saw.
Some say he waits down there to this day,
The town learned from him how to wind the tower,
Each master left the wheel to his apprentice,

tr: Bir kış gecesinde çan susmuş derler.
en: And one winter night, they say, the bell fell still.

tr: Kökü bilen çok, ağacı gören yok.
en: Many know the roots; no one has seen the tree.

tr: Dönmüş de kasaba onu bilmemiş, / Çan çalmış, kimse başın kaldırmamış.
en: He came back, they say, and the town did not know him; / the bell rang, and no one raised their head.

tr: Ne kalmış ne gitmiş, kış sayılmamış, / Kapak kapalıymış, köpek yokmuş derler.
en: He neither stayed nor left; the winters went uncounted; / the hatch was shut, they say, and the dog was gone.

tr: Taş taş sökmüş kuleyi, taşı gömmüş, / Toprak susmuş derler, çan hiç çalmamış.
en: Stone by stone he took the tower down and buried the stone; / the earth went quiet, they say, and the bell never rang.
Rain fell, they say, and no one asked where from.
You never had to go down to come back.
Don't cover it. I won't look.
Master.

tr: Kitabeye bakma. Boş. Kırk yıldır boş.
en: Don't look at the inscription. Empty. Empty for forty years.
Your father. His name is here. Dursun.
I've said it. You'll know.
[water dripping]
[gear catching]
